title: [Linux][Windows] Random freeze happens
body:
### Tested versions

- Godot v4.5.stable.official [876b29033]


### System information

Linux Nobara 42 and windows 10

### Issue description

Hi, 

I migrated my 4.4 project to 4.5. I upgraded all the files through Project > Tools > Upgrade Project Files. I also deleted my .godot folder to generate a new one.

Since then, I have some really frequent crash (3-4 by the hour).  Logs aren't really helpfull, since the app just stop answering and nothing is logged (event if I start the application though the terminal).  

Maybe this could by a club by I'm not sure.

```
ERROR: 211 RID allocations of type 'N10RendererRD14TextureStorage7TextureE' were leaked at exit.
WARNING: 422 RIDs of type "Texture" were leaked.
   at: finalize (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:7191)
WARNING: ObjectDB instances leaked at exit (run with --verbose for details).
   at: cleanup (core/object/object.cpp:2514)
ERROR: 349 resources still in use at exit (run with --verbose for details).
   at: clear (core/io/resource.cpp:795)
```

Here a video of how it crashes while I was writing this issue. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9dcb3c8d-fc82-4957-a62b-0dda625b562a

The same happens on my windows computer but since I deleted .godot, it seems more stable than linux.

### Steps to reproduce

Open a project, way for Godot to crash.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I can't give a project
